Version 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Instantly turn raw video footage (up to 500MB) into polished 1080p MP4 clips with simple, natural prompts.
- No sliders or complex editing—just upload, describe your desired clip, and download your finished video.
- Automated cloud-based editing includes trimming, transitions, and audio/text overlays.
- Designed for TikTok and fast-paced content creators with quick turnaround and easy workflow.
- Built-in free credit system; supports major video and audio formats for export.
